$comment: Knowledge Engine — KB-1 (Platform Knowledge) record. Frozen at major 1 from the reviewed issue #7 draft (specs/knowledge-foundation/schemas, adjusted only in $id path). One record per line in a JSONL partition; this schema also serves as the single-record shape. Magento specifics appear only as VALUES (namespace, nativeId, category), never as schema structure — a non-Magento platform adapter emits identical shapes. Installed != enabled != configured != runtime verified: enablement is data with its own source kind, and proofLevel TESTED may only be backed by runtime/admin evidence.
title: Knowledge Engine — KB-1 Capability / DataProvider record

recordType.$comment: module (M4 additive, issue #19): an installed platform module declaration record (e.g. a Magento module from config.php + module.xml). A module is platform knowledge, not a capability claim — semantics must say so, and category is platform-glue by convention for module inventory records.

id.$comment: Version-free: '<prefix>:<source-namespace>:<kebab-slug>'. The upstream identifier is preserved verbatim in nativeId — never re-slugified.

nativeId.$comment: Identifier exactly as the source declares it, e.g. 'magento_pagebuilder/banner@full-width', 'example_customwidgets/component/banner_a@default'.

platform.$comment: Platform family, e.g. 'magento'. Absent platform = record is not platform knowledge and fails validation.

platformVersion.$comment: Pinned platform version this record was observed at, e.g. '2.4.8-p5'.

category.$comment: Capability family in platform-free vocabulary. Non-exhaustive enum: new families are additive minors.

semantics.$comment: What it does — from declarations/labels only, never inferred behavior claims.

inputs.$comment: Field/schema references by name; field VALUES of secrets never captured.

state.$comment: installed-vs-enabled as data. Absent from the enablement map = 'not-registered' (a distinct fact, observed in the audited checkout).

source.$comment: config-scan proves file state only; runtime-check is the only state that may back TESTED claims.

installed.$comment: Artifact present on disk. Independent of enablement.

declared.$comment: Version the module/package declares about itself.

locked.$comment: Version pinned by the platform's lockfile.

source.$comment: Upstream source version this capability derives from, e.g. '2.8.0'.

schema.$comment: Record-schema version the upstream declares (e.g. component schema_version).

restrictions.$comment: Guards: CSP rules, policy limits, incompatibilities. Facts, not opinions.

locator.$comment: Shape depends on kind. repo-file MUST use rootAlias (resolved from the project's local ignored config / per-run CLI flags) — absolute owner paths are unrepresentable in shared stores.

digest.$comment: sha256 of the artifact at capture time; the re-audit trigger key.

method.$comment: How the claim was established, e.g. 'capability-registry-bridge', 'xml-declaration-scan', 'admin-roundtrip', 'llm-classified' (capped at ASSUMED until human-verified).

uncertainty.$comment: What could invalidate this record — mandatory, may be ['none identified'].

state.$comment: STALE = a tracked digest changed since observed; must re-audit before feeding decisions.

inputDigests.$comment: input path-spec (alias-relative or manifest-relative, exactly as the ingest manifest declared it) -> sha256. The re-audit trigger map: any change here marks the record STALE via det kb sync.
